newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $629 mln for Thursday Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $629 mln for Thursday Nov 7.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $629 million in 33 offerings for Thursday, November 4, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $215 million in 19 offerings. The largest competitive issue is a $72 million Suffolk County, N.Y., general obligation bond issue at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $413 million in 14 offerings. The largest issue is a $125 million California HFA revenue bond issue through Merrill Lynch & Co.
One negotiated deal totaling $24.6 million is on Reuter's day-to-day calendar for Thursday, November 7, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issue depending on market conditions.
